prayerExcerpt.en-US: I will praise you, Lord, among the nations; I will tell of your name to my kin.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Eu vos louvarei, Senhor, entre os povos, e anunciarei vosso nome aos meus irmãos.

meta.face: A weathered Irishman of about seventy, lean and strong, with a fair, windburnt, freckled complexion and a LONG, BIG-BONED face with a strong, JUTTING CHIN — the front of the head shaved from ear to ear in the Irish tonsure, leaving a high, bare, sun-browned forehead, and long red hair gone mostly grey falling from behind the ears to the shoulders; deep-set, pale-blue eyes under bristling reddish-grey brows, crinkled at the corners as against the sea wind; a long, straight, bony nose; wide, flat cheeks; a wide, firm mouth; a short, grizzled red-grey beard close to the jaw; a fearless, far-looking, zealous gaze.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. Art shows him bearded, in the monastic cowl, with a book in an Irish satchel, among wolves or taming a bear, and the Frankish clergy objected to his distinct Irish tonsure, which in some way shaved the head from ear to ear; he was born in Leinster in 543 and died at Bobbio in 615. Colouring and structure are our choice, made Irish and unlike Patrick's card.
